title: yamlfmt config file
description: The yamlfmt config file. For details, see https://github.com/google/yamlfmt/blob/main/docs/config-file.md.

line_ending.description: Parse and write the file with 'lf' or 'crlf' line endings. This global setting will override any formatter line_ending options.

doublestar.description: Use doublestar for include and exclude paths. (This was the default before 0.7.0)

continue_on_error.description: Continue formatting and don't exit with code 1 when there is an invalid yaml file found.

match_style.description: Controls how include and exclude are interpreted. See Specifying Paths for more details.

include.description: The paths for the command to include for formatting. See Specifying Paths for more details.

exclude.description: The paths for the command to exclude from formatting. See Specifying Paths for more details.

gitignore_excludes.description: Use gitignore files for exclude paths. This is in addition to the patterns from the exclude option.

gitignore_path.description: The path to the gitignore file to use.

regex_exclude.description: Regex patterns to match file contents for, if the file content matches the regex the file will be excluded. Use Golang regexes.

extensions.description: The extensions to use for standard mode path collection. See Specifying Paths for more details.

formatter.description: Formatter settings. See Formatter for more details.

indent.description: The indentation level in spaces to use for the formatted yaml.

line_ending.description: Parse and write the file with 'lf' or 'crlf' line endings. This global setting will override any formatter line_ending options.

retain_line_breaks.description: Retain line breaks in formatted yaml.

retain_line_breaks_single.description: Retain line breaks in formatted yaml, but only keep a single line in groups of many blank lines.

disallow_anchors.description: If true, reject any YAML anchors or aliases found in the document.

max_line_length.description: Set the maximum line length (see notes below). if not set, defaults to 0 which means no limit.

scan_folded_as_literal.description: Option that will preserve newlines in folded block scalars (blocks that start with >).

indentless_arrays.description: Render '-' array items (block sequence items) without an increased indent.

drop_merge_tag.description: Assume that any well formed merge using just a << token will be a merge, and drop the !!merge tag from the formatted result.

pad_line_comments.description: The number of padding spaces to insert before line comments.

eof_newline.description: Always add a newline at end of file. Useful in the scenario where retain_line_breaks is disabled but the trailing newline is still needed.

strip_directives.description: YAML Directives are not supported by this formatter. This feature will attempt to strip the directives before formatting and put them back. Use this feature at your own risk.

array_indent.description: Set a different indentation level for block sequences specifically.

indent_root_array.description: Tells the formatter to indent an array that is at the lowest indentation level of the document.

disable_alias_key_correction.description: Disables functionality to fix alias nodes being used as keys.

force_array_style.description: If set, forces arrays to be output in a particular style, either flow ([]) or block (- x). If unset, the style from the original document is used.

force_quote_style.description: If set, forces all nodes with quotes into either single ' or double " quotes.

output_format.description: The output format to use. See Output docs for more details.
